‘Khatron Ke Khiladi’ Season 15 Shooting Update: Rohit Shetty And Contestants Reach Cape Town, Here’s Everything To Know About The New Season
The shoot for ‘Khatron Ke Khiladi’ Season 15 has officially begun in Cape Town, South Africa. Hosted by Rohit Shetty under the theme ‘Darr Ka Naya Daur,’ the new season features a high voltage mix of fresh faces, promising tougher stunts and intense competition.
Ashna ShreeMay 18, 2026, 15:23 IST

Production for the fifteenth season of Colors TV’s OG stunt-based reality show, Khatron Ke Khiladi, has officially commenced. Celebrities and crew members were recently spotted at the Mumbai airport as they departed for Cape Town, South Africa, which returns as the filming destination for the high-intensity series. Filmmaker and action director Rohit Shetty returns to host the franchise following a year-long hiatus. This season is heavily promoted under the tagline "Darr Ka Naya Daur" (A New Era of Fear), promising elevated physical and psychological challenges for the participants.

Contestants Share First Look via Instagram

Now that the shoot has officially begun, the contestants have been actively sharing fun behind-the-scenes moments on social media. From airport selfies to beautiful views of Cape Town, the stars are giving fans a glimpse into their journey from Mumbai to South Africa. Popular TV actor Gaurav Khanna also shared pictures and videos with fellow contestants like Orry, Karan Wahi, Jasmin Bhasin, Harsh Gujral, Rithvik Dhanjani and Avinash Mishra. Their posts show the strong bonding and excitement among the contestants before they begin facing the tough and dangerous stunts. Fans are especially loving these regular updates as they offer a closer look at the fun, nervousness and adventure happening behind the cameras.

‘Khatron Ke Khiladi’ Season 15 Cast

The official contestant lineup for Khatron Ke Khiladi Season 15 features a mix of fresh faces, popular television stars and experienced reality show contestants. Here’s the complete list of participants this season:

Gaurav Khanna
Farrhana Bhat
Avinash Mishra
Shagun Sharma
Ruhaanika Dhawan
Orry
Harsh Gujral

Adding an exciting twist to the season, several former contestants are also making a comeback to raise the entertainment quotient and revive old rivalries. Returning faces include:

Rubina Dilaik
Jasmin Bhasin
Karan Wahi
Rithvik Dhanjani
Vishal Aditya Singh
Avika Gor

Their return is expected to bring more drama, competition and nostalgia for fans of the show. Reports also suggest that Rubina Dilaik and Gaurav Khanna are likely to be among the highest-paid contestants this season due to their massive popularity and successful reality TV journeys.

Rohit Shetty Promises Toughest Season Yet

Cape Town in South Africa has once again been chosen as the shooting location for Khatron Ke Khiladi because of its stunning landscapes, rough terrains and perfect setup for high-risk stunts. Host Rohit Shetty revealed that this season’s challenges have been designed to be tougher than ever before, pushing contestants beyond their comfort zones. From dangerous height stunts and underwater tasks to unexpected encounters with wildlife, the new season promises intense action and thrill. Rohit Shetty will also be seen taking a more active role, motivating and testing the contestants throughout their journey.

Gaurav Khanna Reveals Mother’s Reaction Before Cape Town Shoot

Ahead of his departure, leading contestant Gaurav Khanna briefly made headlines by revealing that his mother was initially opposed to his participation in the gruelling stunt show due to safety concerns. Khatron Ke Khiladi Season 15 is projected to premiere between late June and mid-July 2026. The show will occupy its traditional prime-time weekend slots on Colors TV, with digital streaming rights assigned to the JioHotstar platform for live and on demand viewing.
